title: Elflare/elbot
summary: ElBot 是一个轻量级的 Go 语言编写的 Agent/Chatbot 框架，具有高效的令牌使用、易于管理和感知世界的能力。适用于个人助手、平台机器人以及编排自动化，具有潜在的性能和并发处理优势。
description: "Let ElBot Feel Everything." ElBot is a lightweight Agent/Chatbot framework written in  Go, it's token-efficient, easy to manage, and capable of perceiving the world. Suitable for personal assistants, platform bots, and orchestrated automation.
